The '''''Stellar Mermaid''''' was a [[ZD-8000 cruise ship]], known for its comfort, as well as the matching prices. [[Sard Nightbringer]] tried to auction off a prototype set of Imperial body [[Armor/Legends|armor]] on this ship, in an attempt to raise money for her criminal organization. At the time, it was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Glaucus (Human)|Glaucus]].
